scope: New standalone flow/classifier with stored dialog rendered in React StrictMode/Chromium; synthetic move/read callbacks, not live database/provider E2E
passedDomScenarios: Target reread displays observed result and calls parent observer once without mutation replay
Source observation is not called rollback and does not restore a mutation form
Same-tick reload is single-flight with loading controls disabled
Timeout ignores a later target result
Source context change ignores the previous read
Observer failure preserves observed target state and hides internal details
limits: loadState must be supplied as authenticated read-only transport
No live Supabase Auth/PostgREST or PostgreSQL 17 verification in these tests
